findings.summary: P1-1: the ledger's plan-SHA phrasing was nested, so it labelled the post-amendment SHA as the pre-amendment value in four places.
P2-1: review/round-3/review-metadata.json was written after the 'final' capture, so the precise commit would have omitted the round-3 record.
P3-1: FIX-OX-16 was listed twice in the header and §一 and missing from the §四/§七 enumerations.
P3-2: a stray FIX-OX-14 'commit pending' cell and a stale 'no Push/bump/Release' sentence survived.
P3-3: review status lagged one round in verification-results.json, the ledger and the README.
P3-4: the macOS linker warning stays ledgered against OX-284 final C.
